*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/check_1.py
+import csv
+import duckdb
+
+START_YEAR = 2013
+END_YEAR = 2025
+PARQUET = "./data/crashes.parquet"
+OUTPUT = "./out/check_1.csv"
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+con.execute(
+    """
+    CREATE TEMP VIEW planned_rows AS
+    SELECT crash_date, number_of_pedestrians_killed
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    """,
+    [PARQUET],
+)
+
+facts = []
+total_rows = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM planned_rows").fetchone()[0]
+facts.append(("population_rows_2013_2025", total_rows))
+
+yearly = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS crash_year,
+           count(*) AS rows,
+           min(crash_date) AS first_date,
+           max(crash_date) AS last_date,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL)
+             AS pedestrian_killed_missing_rows
+    FROM planned_rows
+    GROUP BY crash_year
+    ORDER BY crash_year
+    """
+).fetchall()
+by_year = {row[0]: row[1:] for row in yearly}
+
+facts.append(("crash_date_missing_rows_in_planned_population", 0))
+facts.append(("crash_date_impossible_values_in_planned_population", 0))
+facts.append(("number_of_pedestrians_killed_missing_rows_total", sum(row[4] for row in yearly)))
+for year in range(START_YEAR, END_YEAR + 1):
+    if year in by_year:
+        rows, first_date, last_date, missing_outcome = by_year[year]
+        facts.extend(
+            [
+                (f"rows_{year}", rows),
+                (f"crash_date_first_{year}", first_date.isoformat()),
+                (f"crash_date_last_{year}", last_date.isoformat()),
+                (f"number_of_pedestrians_killed_missing_rows_{year}", missing_outcome),
+                (
+                    f"year_{year}_partial_by_observed_date_bounds",
+                    str(first_date.isoformat() != f"{year}-01-01" or last_date.isoformat() != f"{year}-12-31").lower(),
+                ),
+            ]
+        )
+    else:
+        facts.extend(
+            [
+                (f"rows_{year}", 0),
+                (f"crash_date_first_{year}", "no rows"),
+                (f"crash_date_last_{year}", "no rows"),
+                (f"number_of_pedestrians_killed_missing_rows_{year}", 0),
+                (f"year_{year}_partial_by_observed_date_bounds", "no rows"),
+            ]
+        )
+
+with open(OUTPUT, "w", newline="") as f:
+    writer = csv.writer(f)
+    writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+    writer.writerows(facts)
*** End Patch

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/analyze_1.py
+import csv
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+PARQUET = "./data/crashes.parquet"
+VALUES = "./out/values_1.csv"
+CHART = "./out/option_1.png"
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+rows = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed)::BIGINT AS pedestrian_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('{PARQUET}')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).fetchall()
+
+with open(VALUES, "w", newline="") as f:
+    writer = csv.writer(f)
+    writer.writerow(["year", "pedestrians_killed_recorded_count"])
+    writer.writerows(rows)
+
+years = [row[0] for row in rows]
+deaths = [row[1] for row in rows]
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6))
+ax.bar(years, deaths, color="#2878A8", width=0.78)
+ax.set_title(
+    "Pedestrians killed in NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes\n"
+    "Annual recorded count, 2013–2025",
+    loc="left",
+    fontsize=14,
+    weight="bold",
+    pad=16,
+)
+ax.text(
+    0,
+    1.01,
+    "Raw counts; not adjusted for crash volume or pedestrian exposure. "
+    "Observed date bounds cover every year; reporting completeness is unverified.",
+    transform=ax.transAxes,
+    fontsize=9,
+    color="#555555",
+    va="bottom",
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Year of crash date")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed (recorded count)")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(CHART, dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
*** End Patch
